findings: The headline as printed (l.2363, Cauchy-complete) is supported only in DEC-28's Cauchy-compact form; the form of record GX.btz_uniformization (DEC-107 C¹ Cauchy-compact, DEC-119 π₁ free non-abelian) is now on standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (campaign/WP-47g/axioms.out): the upstream mixed-diamond leaf is proved (WP-47f) and the developed BTZ half-line is built (WP-47e).

The display l.2369 is wrong (D-12 (c)); certified (DEC-28): range d.D = (⋃ₓ Δₓ) ∪ Ω⁺(Λ), Ω⁺(Λ) = ⋂_w I⁺(Π_w), with Δₓ = 𝒟(sing M~) ∩ J⁺(𝒟x) ∖ {𝒟x} (GX.btzTildeDelta) = {𝒟x + λu, λ > 0}, u future null ≠ 0, Δₓ ⊆ ∂Ω⁺, the family ρ(Γ)-invariant, ⋃ Δₓ = 𝒟(sing M~) disjoint from Ω⁺.

Every bullet of the headline is proved in GX.btz_uniformization: D injective on all of M~ (btz_injective_dev_C1); ρ faithful, discrete, torsion-free; the planes; the rays and the image; and ρ(Γ)\𝒟(M~) ≃ₜ M by [𝒟 e] ↦ p(e) (btzTilde_quotient_homeomorph, through GX.quotient_virtually_tame and btz_manifold_isGaloisian), with the isometry Reg M ≅ ρ(Γ)\Ω⁺. Equivariance at the BTZ points (D∘φ = ρ(φ)·D for every deck φ of M~ → M), which the proof (l.2382–2397) uses without comment, is proved (btzTilde_dev_deck) by T_BTZ-density of reg M~ and T_BTZ-continuity of deck maps.

The proof's 'S_x is a totally ordered relatively open future half line, so is its image' (l.2385–2386) needs a BTZ point strictly below each BTZ point on its developed line; proved (btzTilde_exists_sing_below) through one descending chart along the full future BTZ ray of p(x) started slightly in the past of p(x) — the openness of the domain W of the ray's E₀-morphism.

WP-47g fixer (audit major 1): the proof's identification l.2390–2395 ('the image of such D(I_{p,q}) together with the topology induced by M generates the BTZ topology on D(M~)') is PROVED: GX.BTZTildeData.btzRangeTop_eq_devImageTop — defi:BTZtop traced on D(M~) near the rays (GX.btzRangeTop) equals the topology generated by M3 and the D-images of T_BTZ-opens. The proof does not need the paper's causally convex chart neighbourhoods I_{p,q}: at a regular point D is a local homeomorphism; at a BTZ point y, in a developed chart κ (D = g·val∘κ), the BTZ topology of J+(Δ0) has the basic neighbourhoods A ∩ (I+(p_{t−η}) ∪ ]p_{t−η},+∞[) (GX.btzJ0_exists_basic_of_mem_nhds, from the axis diamonds of btz_axis_diamond), the regular points of a BTZ chart are off Δ0 (GX.BTZTildeData.exists_nhds_sing_of_mem_btzLine), and g sends Δ0 onto the developed half-line with its orientation, g·p_{t+s} = Dz + (s c) u, c > 0 (GX.btzTilde_chart_align). The headline's last conjunct is now ρ(Γ)\D(M~) ≃ₜ M with D(M~) carrying btzRangeTop (GX.btzTilde_quotient_homeomorph_btzTop), so the bullet is a statement about a BTZ topology on a subset of M3, not a transported topology.

WP-47g fixer (audit minor 2): the two halves of 'isomorphism' are PROVED compatible and the compatibility is a conjunct of GX.btz_uniformization: for every isometry f : Reg M ≅ B onto a presentation π : Ω+ → B of ρ(Γ)\Ω+ with f ∘ p = π ∘ D (the first block's), the homeomorphism h satisfies h [D e] = f⁻¹(π (D e)) for every regular e (GX.btzTilde_quotient_compat, via E0Bridge.proj_regTildeHomeo).

WP-47g fixer (audit minor 3): not a reading — the family (Δi) of l.2368 is existential; the witness (Δx)_{x BTZ}, Δx = {Dx + λu, λ>0}, is relatively open, future complete and lightlike, ρ(Γ)-invariant as a family, contained in ∂Ω+, with union D(sing M~) and D(M~) = (⋃Δx) ∪ ⋂ I+(Πw). The paper's maximal D(S_x) is its proof's choice of witness; each Δx is a sub-ray of it.

WP-47g fixer round 2 (audit major): the headline's last bullet 'isomorphism M → ρ\D(M~)' is PROVED as an isomorphism of singular (Isom 𝐌³, 𝐌³)-manifolds, as the audit prescribed: ρ(Γ)\D(M~) (quotient of D(M~) with defi:BTZtop near the rays) carries the unique maximal a.e. atlas for which the projection M~ → ρ(Γ)\D(M~), e ↦ [D e], is an a.e. morphism (M~ with the structure p^*B_M of prop:singular_manifold_branched_covering), and for it the homeomorphism h : ρ(Γ)\D(M~) ≃ₜ M, [D e] ↦ p(e), and its inverse are a.e. morphisms (GX.btzTilde_quotient_aeIso, conjuncts of GX.btz_uniformization). The previous round's claim that 'ρ\D(M~) carries no singular (G,X)-structure in the library' was wrong and is withdrawn (SCOPE (b) (ii) rewritten). Every assertion of the DEC-28 form is now proved; the row stays partial only because DEC-28 itself rules it partial (Cauchy-complete strengthened to Cauchy-compact, DEC-27).
questions: DEC-28 rules this row partial (Cauchy-complete → Cauchy-compact, DEC-27). Every assertion of the DEC-28 form, with DEC-107's C¹ reading of Cauchy-compact and DEC-119's 'π₁ free and non-abelian', is now proved in GX.btz_uniformization on standard axioms, the 'isomorphism' bullet in the twins' a.e.-isomorphism sense. Does the author accept the DEC-28 form as the corrected statement in DEC-27's sense ('row partial unless a ruling accepts the corrected form, then CLOSED'), so that the row CLOSES and is marked, or does DEC-28's 'the row is partial with findings' stand?

hypotheses.note: DEC-77's ACCEPTED corrected form: Cauchy-compact (DEC-107: ∃ S, IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy M S) + Cauchy-maximal + π₁(Reg M) not metabelian (implied by DEC-119's free and non-abelian) + a BTZ point (s ≥ 1, DEC-76); the printed hypothesis alone (DEC-31 = IsE0CauchyComplete) is refuted by {τ<0} (GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC118)

DEC-118 (a)'s ruled reading BTZTildeData.IsBTZFutureComplete M d for every presentation Φ and every chartwise datum d with d.D = D on reg M~ (DEC-118 (c)); the existence of such d is proved in the same statement; both inclusions of J⁺ and I⁺ at EVERY point

findings: As printed the proposition is false (D-11, DEC-77), now refuted with the PRINTED hypothesis AND the RULED conclusion: GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC118 (0 sorry, standard axioms) — {τ<0} ⊂ E0 is GH, Cauchy-complete in DEC-31's sense (GX.e0PastHalf_isE0CauchyComplete), has BTZ points, and NO datum of {τ<0}~ (any base point, any presentation, chartwise or not) satisfies BTZTildeData.IsBTZFutureComplete (GX.e0PastHalf_not_isBTZFutureComplete: on reg M~, r = a ∘ D with a affine; for regular x every w ≫ x is regular with r(x) ≤ r(w) ≤ r(x) − 2τ(x), so a is bounded on the open cone I+(Dx) = D(I+(x)), hence constant, while r takes the values 1 and 2). The Reg-part reading fails as well (GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC31).

The proof's l.2350 omits that Barbot's future completeness needs equality D(reg M~) = Omega+, i.e. absolute maximality (B21 Cor 2.18) and the future case; the proof cites 'Lemma 2.4' for what is B21 Lemma 2.3 (D-11 (b)).

The proof's two steps (Reg M~ future complete, l.2350; full BTZ rays, l.2352) do not by themselves give « M future complete » in DEC-118 (a)'s reading: J+ in Reg M~ is not J+ in M~. Round 2 supplies the transport of Reg M~'s causality into M~'s (GX.btzTilde_transport) and the BTZ-point charts (GX.BTZTildeData.chart_notMem_btzJReg_of_sing); what the paper's « Lemma 2.4 implies full BTZ rays » still leaves implicit is that the ray of M lifts to M~ and develops onto the whole null half-line (GX.btzTilde_null_supset).
WP-47g: the last case (the future half of the developed BTZ line at a BTZ point) is closed by GX.futureRay_null_supset (WP-47e, DEC-126); GX.btz_isBTZFutureComplete_C1 is on standard axioms.

kb_proposals: To use GX.quotient_virtually_tame on the chartwise M~ you need its T_BTZ to be TAMIFYING; build the datum from btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg directly (GX.btzTilde_exists_tamifying_extending) — BTZTildeData itself does not record tamifiability.

Deck transformations of M~ → M correspond to Causal.Deck of the universal cover of Reg M by conjugating the restriction with E0Bridge.regTildeHomeo (GX.btzTildeDeckConj, surjective via GX.exists_deck_extend); equivariance then extends to BTZ points by T_BTZ-density (tamifying field isPortly) — GX.btzTilde_dev_deck.

Instance clash: functions on MaxBranchedCover with T'.top must be stated on d.Space (WithWrappedTop) to use Continuous.ext_on / mem_closure_image; @-forms with d.T'.top fail with 'synthesized instance not defeq'.
A point of M~ causally after a REGULAR point is regular once d.D is injective and Reg M~ future complete (GX.btzTilde_not_sing_of_le_reg): the cheap way to show a developed point is (not) BTZ.

defi:BTZtop on a developed image: near a point of Δ0, J+(Δ0)'s BTZ topology has the explicit basis I⁻(P_η) ∩ (I+(p_{t−η}) ∪ ]p_{t−η},+∞[) — GX.btzJ0_exists_basic_of_mem_nhds (pull the neighbourhood back by btzJDev to hornTop's apex basis, then btz_axis_diamond); use it instead of re-deriving the generateFrom neighbourhood filter.

Instance trap on d.Space vs MaxBranchedCover: `Continuous.isOpen_preimage`/`.preimage` re-synthesise the source instance (SpreadEnd's) and reject `d.continuous_D`; use `d.continuous_dev` (stated on d.Space) or state goals as `IsOpen[d.T'.top] _`; `@IsOpen d.Space _ O` to read a T'-open set on d.Space.

'Isomorphism of singular manifolds' for a homeomorphism h : Q ≃ₜ M onto a singular (G,X)-manifold, with h ∘ π = p for a branched covering p : N → M: pull M's atlas back along h (aePullback_spec_of_isAELocalHomeomorph with Reg M as the portly set), h.symm by IsAEMorphismOf.symm_of_homeomorph, π = h.symm ∘ p an a.e. morphism by comp with singular_manifold_branched_covering, uniqueness by IsAEMorphismOf.eq_of_isMaximalAEAtlas_right — GX.btz_aeIso_of_homeomorph_comp (the pattern of tamely_singular_manifold_admits_aeIso with h given). Do not claim a quotient carries 'no singular structure in the library' before grepping SingularGXStructure / existsUnique_aeGXQuotient.
